scope: Generation quality on public SQuAD 1.1 dev questions with human reference answers, full 2,067-passage corpus, recursive hybrid + neural-reranked retrieval, Qwen3 4B-Instruct (Q4_K_M) via private Ollama on CPU. Not a domain certification.

method.development_set: seed 42, 200 questions; used to diagnose failures and tune the gate/prompt
method.held_out_set: seed 7, 200 questions, zero overlap with the development set; never inspected before the final run
method.correctness: Delivered answers containing a normalized reference span count as correct. Every delivered answer without a span match was reviewed individually against the references and question by the AI assistant (Claude) that built the system; this is a single, non-independent reviewer, so treat adjudication as indicative.
method.strict_policy_counterfactual: Each run also records whether the previous policy (all claims must pass the fast verifier; no escalation, no partial delivery) would have accepted the same answer, isolating the gate change from prompt and sampling differences.

findings: Wrong delivered answers are almost all grounded in a retrieved passage but answer a different reading of a context-dependent question (SQuAD questions were written for one passage, e.g. 'the stadium the teams played in'). The NLI gate verifies support, not that the answer addresses the intended question.
The largest loss is model refusal despite retrieving the gold passage (11.5% held-out); the 4B model is conservative under strict grounding instructions.
Escalation to the stronger NLI model and partial delivery added 14 held-out answers, 13 correct, at ~0.16 s per escalated premise.
The 4B model as its own judge was unreliable in probes (accepted an unstated date, rejected a correct paraphrase) and is not used.

answer_recovery_release.final_set: seed 11, 200 questions, zero overlap with seeds 42/7 generation runs and the 100-question SQuAD reports; never inspected before this run
changes: hedge salvage of cited facts from refusals
rank guard: decline when every citation ranks 8th or lower
retry with rewritten search query (implemented, off by default: recovered 0/16 on tuning set)
adjudication_final_wrong: rotary engine without pistons (Quasiturbine; ref Wankel)
extent of Céloron's expedition (route; ref ~3,000 miles)
vice presidents on the Student Board (salvage)
adjudication_final_correct_without_span_: health and social problems with income inequality
conclusions: Same-question gain is small: +3 correct (+1.5 points) and +1 wrong; the sample's easier questions explain most of the difference from the 75.5% seed-7 figure.
Salvage is the only change with a measured positive effect on both sets (16 of 20 salvaged answers correct).
The rank guard did not generalize (3 of 4 declined answers were correct on fresh data; 4 of 7 wrong pooled). It is kept as a precision control but is not a coverage improvement.
Retry recovers nothing with Qwen3-4B; the binding constraint is the generator, not retrieval (95.5% recall@10).
The checker still withholds 8 answers whose raw text contained the reference: the next lever is verifier recall, not generation.

model_selection.scope: Paired local generation-model evaluation: same public SQuAD query sample, same recursive hybrid + neural-reranked retrieval, same production grounding gate (verify_answer). Not a domain certification.

summary.limitations: Generator backend is explicit; NLI is an imperfect automated contextual-support measurement, not a truth oracle.

after.nli_premise: 1-3 sentence windows + passage, top-8 lexical candidates per claim

manual_adjudication.scope: Single-reviewer check of 30 sampled cases; not a statistically powered hallucination estimate.

model_selection.decision: Default local generator: qwen3:4b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M. Higher delivered-correct coverage (0.667 vs 0.533) and half the unsupported-claim rate (0.096 vs 0.204) at ~2.3x median latency (7.3 s vs 3.2 s on CPU) and ~2.5 GB model weights. qwen3:1.7b remains a lower-latency/memory option.
model_selection.note: Per-answer cases for this 30-question comparison are in git history (evals/reports/generation_models.json before the repository tidy).
